name: Focal Point Presence
summary:
Focal Point Presence is a technical showcase for Focal Point VR’s immersive live streaming technology.

The app lets you experience selected VR video demonstrations captured using FPVR camera systems and processed through the company’s live stream processor and Segmented Fidelity Streaming workflow. The goal is simple: to show how high-resolution immersive video can bring viewers closer to live events, with a stronger sense of presence than conventional flat video.
